title: kith-events: TypeFilter mentioned in existing issue KITH-hqrw.69 — verify no new surface in lib.rs
description: kith-events lib.rs has no TypeFilter — it exports only make_channel, EventSender, EventReceiver, StateChange. KITH-hqrw.69 refers to TypeFilter silently dropping unknown type names in allows(). This filter does not appear in the reviewed code. Either the TypeFilter lives in kithd (not in scope) or was removed. No new surface to review here — the lib.rs is clean.
